can choose a model and reasoning effort for delegated Workflow tasks</span></li><li><span>When <code class="docs-code-inline">/goal</code> replaces an earlier goal, the agent is now told which goal was replaced, so it no longer mistakes the replacement for a cancellation</span></li></ul><h3 id="fixes-7" class="docs-h docs-h3">Fixes<a class="docs-anchor" href="#fixes-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Ask me and Auto-review now ask before running <code class="docs-code-inline">find -delete</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec rm</code> (such as <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec rm &#x27;{}&#x27; \;</code>) or <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec &#x27;{}&#x27;</code>, as they already did for <code class="docs-code-inline">find | xargs rm</code>, instead of running it without asking; <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec</code> with plain programs such as <code class="docs-code-inline">grep</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">chmod</code> still runs, while some other launches such as <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sudo rm -rf &#x27;{}&#x27; +</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sh &#x27;{}&#x27; \;</code> now ask too; a <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sh -c &#x27;…&#x27;</code> script can still run without asking, even one that deletes files</span></li><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Ask me and Auto-review now also ask before running a <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec</code> that reaches <code class="docs-code-inline">rm</code> or the matched file through <code class="docs-code-inline">sudo</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">env</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">setsid</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">nice</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">nohup</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">timeout</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">stdbuf</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">time</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">command</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">xargs</code> (for example <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sudo rm &#x27;{}&#x27; \;</code>), instead of running it without asking, and before a <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sudo</code> whose options it cannot read, even when the launched program is not <code class="docs-code-inline">rm</code> (for example <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sudo --bogus cat &#x27;{}&#x27; \;</code>); a known wrapper that launches a program such as <code class="docs-code-inline">cat</code> (<code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec sudo cat &#x27;{}&#x27; +</code>) still runs, and so does the matched file itself (<code class="docs-code-inline">&#x27;{}&#x27;</code>) behind another wrapper such as <code class="docs-code-inline">ionice</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">doas</code></span></li><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Ask me and Auto-review now also ask before running a <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec</code> that launches <code class="docs-code-inline">rm</code> behind a wrapper they do not otherwise know, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">ionice</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">doas</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">flock</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">chrt</code> (for example <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec ionice rm &#x27;{}&#x27; \;</code>); <code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec chmod</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">mv</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">sed -i</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">grep</code> still run without asking unless the command itself would ask (an argument named <code class="docs-code-inline">rm</code> alone does not make them ask), and so does such a wrapper launching the matched file itself (<code class="docs-code-inline">find -exec ionice &#x27;{}&#x27; \;</code>)</span></li><li><span>When another program replaces a session&#x27;s lock file while Muse is running (for example a sync between machines), side chat and fork now explain what happened and that restarting the Muse process holding the session fixes it (the message names it), instead of a cryptic lock error</span></li><li><span>Sessions with an active <code class="docs-code-inline">/goal</code> now save their resume checkpoint at compaction instead of losing it to goal usage tracking, including after the goal is paused, resumed, or replaced. If goal usage truly cannot be recorded, that compaction skips its checkpoint with the reason in the session log, and the next compaction tries again</span></li><li><span>Subagent rows, queued counts, and child views now stay in sync when the experimental TUI client is on, foreign assistant turns no longer stamp the live answer, sent input feeds the same queue the counts read, and resumed sessions reseed their child threads</span></li><li><span>Keep an image tied to its original message when background compaction drops a video that could not be sent with it</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/plan</code> on a small change now returns a plan instead of making the edit</span></li><li><span>Resuming a long session no longer marks an already-finished turn as cancelled, and the session keeps saving resume checkpoints afterward instead of replaying ever more history</span></li><li><span>When compaction cannot safely keep part of a conversation, such as a video, it now reports a normal compaction failure that tells you to start a new session with <code class="docs-code-inline">/new</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">/clear</code> instead of an internal error</span></li><li><span>Keep an image tied to its original message when older tool output carried over from earlier turns is cleared from context</span></li><li><span>A logged-out <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> host now gives new sessions your configured permission profile and sandbox flags instead of silently starting them as Ask me; an Auto-review profile is refused with the reviewer-unavailable reason</span></li><li><span>A skill already read in an earlier run of the same session is no longer reminded again in the next run; the reminder observer and admission now honor prior-run reads</span></li><li><span>The published session protocol schema now accepts the <code class="docs-code-inline">null</code> the host already sends for <code class="docs-code-inline">session/goalChanged.goal</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/branchChanged.branch</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/modelChanged.providerId</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/modelRouteUnserved.providerId</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/tokenUsage.modelId</code> and a failed skill import&#x27;s <code class="docs-code-inline">id</code>, so clients that validate host messages against it no longer reject them; in the generated TypeScript and Python types these members are now required and may be <code class="docs-code-inline">null</code></span></li><li><span>Messages sent during a reply still run after <code class="docs-code-inline">/goal pause</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">/goal clear</code></span></li><li><span>Stop automatic continuation when a reminder is rejected, snoozed or fails without fresh guidance</span></li><li><span>Resuming a session with a very large saved snapshot now reports the snapshot size when it cannot be read</span></li><li><span>After a rewind or a return from <code class="docs-code-inline">/side</code>, a finished subagent hidden from the current subagent tree view no longer reappears when its workspace cleanup is reported</span></li><li><span>Permission profiles with filesystem rules the session cannot enforce (extra file or home-directory paths, workspace subrules, deny patterns, altered temp or root accesses, missing minimal read set, added workspace roots, or socket rules) are now refused at selection with the reason, instead of silently running read-only; setting <code class="docs-code-inline">MUSE_PERMISSION_PROFILE_FAIL_OPEN=1</code> restores the old read-only fallback with a startup warning</span></li><li><span>Limit retries when saving a Monitor&#x27;s final state and report when it cannot be confirmed</span></li><li><span>In containers where the sandbox cannot start, trusted workspaces can create session and subagent worktrees again, and untrusted workspaces get a clear refusal instead of a Git error</span></li><li><span>A network request that arrives while an identical request from the same tool call is already waiting for your answer now joins that prompt instead of opening a second one and running a second Auto-review; a different command in the same run keeps its own prompt</span></li><li><span>Long sessions that get a scheduled or background notification at almost every step now resume quickly from their latest compaction instead of rereading most of the session log</span></li><li><span>Queued /goal edits now deliver in the order they were accepted even when the system clock moves backward between them, instead of replaying newest-first</span></li><li><span>A workflow launch that was cancelled before it started is now recorded as cancelled; a saved session whose history leaves such a launch in doubt refuses to open with an error naming the launch instead of guessing, and a session whose cancel hit a storage error part-way reopens and finishes that bookkeeping instead of refusing to open</span></li><li><span>When picking up a handed-over or resumed plan, the agent re-checks the plan&#x27;s next step against evidence that arrived after the plan was approved before starting long work on it</span></li><li><span>Clear leftover spaces when loading and indexing messages disappear from the session picker</span></li><li><span>The published session protocol schema now accepts the <code class="docs-code-inline">null</code> the host sends for a root session&#x27;s <code class="docs-code-inline">sideFrom</code> and an unnamed session&#x27;s snapshot <code class="docs-code-inline">name</code>; both stay optional in the generated TypeScript and Python types</span></li><li><span>Closing the terminal while a hook is still running now stops the hook and the processes it started, instead of leaving them running after Muse Code exits</span></li><li><span>Continue unfinished work after a failed goal check only when usable guidance remains</span></li><li><span>Stopping or backgrounding a task that already finished before the session was reopened now gets the already-finished answer instead of <code class="docs-code-inline">invalid_target</code></span></li><li><span>TUI /export falls back to the OS temp dir when the target directory is unwritable, and transcript failures name the intended file</span></li><li><span>Starting with no model configured and a cold model cache now resolves the default model from the freshly fetched catalog instead of stopping with a missing-default error</span></li><li><span>A renamed session now updates in an open session picker right away</span></li><li><span>When a turn fails while draining hook continuations after a <code class="docs-code-inline">PostToolBatch</code> commit and the first write of its <code class="docs-code-inline">Failed</code> terminal does not land, the run is now closed with exactly one durable <code class="docs-code-inline">Failed</code> terminal instead of being left open</span></li><li><span>After a rewind or a return from <code class="docs-code-inline">/side</code>, a finished subagent hidden from the current subagent tree view no longer reappears when a new subagent with the same role starts or a late message to it is settled</span></li><li><span>Clearing a goal whose store cannot be read now reports the store as unavailable instead of claiming no goal is set</span></li><li><span>Escape returns directly to the composer from a workflow opened below it</span></li><li><span>Resumed older sessions and subagents now save a resume point at every compaction, and sessions holding an older-format resume point reopen without rereading the whole log</span></li><li><span>If Muse cannot read a chat&#x27;s session log when the chat starts, the chat now fails to open with an error that names the failed read, and reopening retries it. Before, the chat opened but /new, /clear, /resume, fork and rewind failed until Muse restarted, and the next resume wrongly reported that the previous run had ended abnormally</span></li><li><span>When a disk fault left a live permission-profile change half-written, Muse could fall back to the old permissions even though the change might already be saved. Muse now finishes the interrupted write first: the change completes normally when that works, and otherwise the session stops accepting permission changes instead of falling back to the old permissions</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">-c session_retention_days=N</code> sets retention for one run</span></li><li><span>Approval prompts open at the first choice instead of inheriting a previous Abort highlight</span></li><li><span>Session lists no longer fail after an interrupted update</span></li><li><span>File tools accept relative paths with <code class="docs-code-inline">..</code> that resolve inside an allowed workspace root instead of refusing them</span></li><li><span>Improve context compaction timing across turns and after clearing old tool results</span></li><li><span>The file-tool watchdog row no longer promises &quot;Esc to cancel&quot; while an async question owns Esc; the hint hides until the question editor closes</span></li><li><span>Stopping a background task on the first reopen after the app closed unexpectedly now gets the already-finished answer instead of <code class="docs-code-inline">invalid_target</code></span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">web_fetch</code> now honors a live Unrestricted permission profile on every fetch, fresh, switched, and resumed sessions skip the per-host approval like <code class="docs-code-inline">--yolo</code>: and reads profile static network targets before session rules, matching the shell order</span></li><li><span>Editing or pausing a goal no longer resets its progress-reminder timing</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> now prints a line naming any session whose saved view could not be brought up to date at shutdown, instead of exiting with no sign of it</span></li><li><span>Under <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code>, a running or finished subagent or workflow child&#x27;s conversation is now readable over <code class="docs-code-inline">session/read</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">view/page</code> from any client</span></li><li><span>Monitor watches over the new session connection now show their end marker (<code class="docs-code-inline">Monitor &quot;name&quot; — ended</code> / <code class="docs-code-inline">— failed</code> with the reason) and resume without doubling rows</span></li><li><span>Changing a <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> session&#x27;s permission profile while it runs now keeps the approval mode the client selected</span></li><li><span>Session lists stay available after an interrupted upgrade</span></li><li><span>Transcript rows left in-progress when a turn ends now settle as failed instead of hanging</span></li><li><span>Final answers report only the quantities asked for; extra accounting goes to a linked file instead of the chat answer</span></li><li><span>A workflow child that the model provider rejected as rate limited, overloaded or with a server error now reports that as its error kind</span></li><li><span>Opening <code class="docs-code-inline">/permissions</code> immediately after session start no longer fails with &quot;Session permission state is incomplete.&quot;; the picker waits for permission state to load</span></li><li><span>Gate-on <code class="docs-code-inline">/new</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">/clear</code> no longer stall ~30s on sessions that start no MCP servers; the fresh-session handoff settles as soon as the host reports no startup task instead of waiting out the full settle bound</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> answers the app right away on a machine with no saved model list, instead of waiting for the model list download; the model picker and new sessions wait for the list</span></li><li><span>A session whose Workflow launch was cancelled before its owner bound it now shows the same &quot;history unreadable&quot; state whether it is read from the session cache or loaded in full</span></li><li><span>Resumed workflows keep their recorded names</span></li><li><span>A <code class="docs-code-inline">Notification</code> hook no longer freezes the session while an always-allow rule is being saved to a stalled disk; the approval reports the save timeout instead</span></li></ul><h3 id="performance-7" class="docs-h docs-h3">Performance<a class="docs-anchor" href="#performance-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> answers <code class="docs-code-inline">initialize</code> without first scanning every retained session</span></li><li><span>Resuming a session whose workflows ran hundreds of agents spends far less time rebuilding the workflow view</span></li></ul><h2 id="v1-4-5" class="docs-h docs-h2">1.4.5<a class="docs-anchor" href="#v1-4-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><h3 id="new-8" class="docs-h docs-h3">New<a class="docs-anchor" href="#new-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Turn on Automatic session naming in <code class="docs-code-inline">/settings</code> to have each session named with a short Name and a Description; a name you set with <code class="docs-code-inline">/name</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">/rename</code> always wins</span></li></ul><h3 id="improvements-8" class="docs-h docs-h3">Improvements<a class="docs-anchor" href="#improvements-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>A turn that stops because the session&#x27;s MCP link could not be confirmed now reports its own <code class="docs-code-inline">mcpLinkError</code> turn error kind instead of a generic configuration error</span></li><li><span>Apps and SDKs can switch a session to a model id that is not in the model list, on the same provider, as <code class="docs-code-inline">--model</code> already allows at launch; a mistyped id is no longer refused at switch time and fails on the next turn instead</span></li><li><span>When a resumed session can&#x27;t replay its earlier private reasoning to the current model, the error now tells you to start a new session to continue and confirms the session&#x27;s history is kept</span></li><li><span>Session-protocol clients can import foreign skills over <code class="docs-code-inline">skill/import</code>: bring Claude or Codex skills into the user collection (or preview the run with a dry run) through the same shared pipeline the app uses, with installed, quarantined, skipped, and failed sets in the receipt</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/model &lt;model-id&gt;</code> switches to that model directly, without the picker; an id that is not in the model list applies to this session only and is not saved</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> now keeps up to 256 sessions loaded at once instead of 32, raises its own open-file limit at startup to hold them, and when the system&#x27;s open-file limit still cannot hold another session it refuses that load with a message naming the limit instead of failing mid-load</span></li><li><span>Claude plugins whose hooks name events Muse does not run (such as <code class="docs-code-inline">TaskCompleted</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">TeammateIdle</code>) now install; each such hook is skipped with a warning that names the event, and the plugin&#x27;s other hooks, skills, and commands work</span></li><li><span>A workflow&#x27;s row on the main screen now shows the workflow page&#x27;s colored progress bar before its agent count</span></li><li><span>With Automatic session naming on, the bottom status row and <code class="docs-code-inline">/status</code> show the generated short Name; <code class="docs-code-inline">/status</code> keeps the session name that <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> uses in parentheses</span></li></ul><h3 id="fixes-8" class="docs-h docs-h3">Fixes<a class="docs-anchor" href="#fixes-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Static target matching now resolves hex, octal, and shorthand IPv4 spellings the way the proxy does, so wildcard allows can no longer admit a non-public destination through an alternate spelling; IP rules must use canonical strict literals, and anything else falls through to a prompt</span></li><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> The <code class="docs-code-inline">write_file</code> near-duplicate note no longer names a credential file, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">.netrc</code>, that sits next to the file you created</span></li><li><span>Keep images tied to their original message after background context compaction</span></li><li><span>A brief server error no longer ends a chat right away when its model isn&#x27;t in your model list; the request is retried again</span></li><li><span>Sessions holding an older checkpoint above a newer capable one now reopen instead of failing every resume</span></li><li><span>Monitor start guidance now names the sanctioned wait, end the turn when nothing else needs doing, because event batches wake the session, so a model watching a quiet job no longer fills the wait with sleep runs, log polling, or invented placeholder tool calls</span></li><li><span>Keep images sent in later turns tied to their original message after periodic context saves</span></li><li><span>When creating an operating-system socket fails with EPERM (for example crashpad&#x27;s <code class="docs-code-inline">socketpair</code> under a headless browser), the failure now carries guidance that names the sandbox as a possible cause with a probe to verify attribution, instead of no guidance</span></li><li><span>Restore complete bulk stop notifications when reopening a session</span></li><li><span>Background context compaction works after resuming a session, and your next message is no longer rejected when a background compaction cannot be applied</span></li><li><span>Queued messages left behind after a turn ends no longer get stuck, press ↑ at idle to pull them back into the composer, then edit and send them or clear them</span></li><li><span>Keep subagent answers visible after the parent reads their result</span></li><li><span>Forking a session that was rewound in an older version, or whose compacted history ends with a summary note, now gives a fork that every client can open</span></li><li><span>Keep an image tied to its original message when compaction during a turn or <code class="docs-code-inline">/compact</code> removes a video sent in that same message</span></li><li><span>Sandboxed Linux commands no longer fail with &quot;Argument list too long&quot; when the inherited environment is large; the environment and profile now travel to the sandbox helper as staged files instead of command-line arguments</span></li><li><span>Hosts allowed in a permission profile now load from the sandboxed shell through the per-launch proxy instead of failing DNS resolution, and statically denied hosts fail without prompting</span></li><li><span>A long-running background command (a watch loop or dev server) no longer keeps your next message waiting behind log cleanup</span></li><li><span>Headless browsers (chrome-headless-shell, Firefox) and other tools that open anonymous AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpairs now run in the managed Linux sandbox under Restricted and ProxyOnly network modes; re-addressable datagram pairs stay denied (full-Chrome headless still cannot take its ProcessSingleton lock under the filter)</span></li><li><span>The TypeScript SDK no longer asks <code class="docs-code-inline">onApproval</code> again about a multi-stage approval the host already closed, when the closing decision&#x27;s reply and the final stage update arrive together</span></li><li><span>The Python SDK no longer opens a console window on Windows when it starts <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> from an app without its own console, such as a GUI app or a service</span></li><li><span>A chat that used a plugin recording session events is no longer refused after you switch it to another provider&#x27;s model and resume it in an app</span></li><li><span>Shell writes to /dev/shm now persist for the rest of the session instead of silently vanishing after each command, and other writes directly under /dev now fail visibly</span></li><li><span>Every <code class="docs-code-inline">-32030</code> <code class="docs-code-inline">commandRejected</code> with reason <code class="docs-code-inline">runtime_busy</code> now reports <code class="docs-code-inline">retryable: true</code>, including the ones that reported <code class="docs-code-inline">false</code> before (a <code class="docs-code-inline">turn/start</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">turn/steer</code> refused while another session&#x27;s turn is running, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/rename</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/userShell</code>, workflow pause, cancel and child control); retry after a short wait, and switch to a fresh <code class="docs-code-inline">commandId</code> if the same one keeps returning <code class="docs-code-inline">runtime_busy</code></span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> refusal for a sequence-holed retained session names the expected and found gap positions</span></li><li><span>A session you started with an explicit approval mode and then left without sending a message is now cleaned up like any other empty session, instead of staying in your session list with no turns</span></li><li><span>When context compaction can&#x27;t confirm where an older image came from, it now leaves a short note in the image&#x27;s place and keeps going instead of stopping the run; the image stays in the session history</span></li><li><span>A temporary (not logged) session, or a resumed session from before permission profiles were recorded, no longer reports a read-only permission profile that nothing enforced; it reports the profile it actually enforces, or no profile when none is in effect</span></li><li><span>Stopping or backgrounding a task from an older session now gets the normal answer (finished, accepted, or not found) instead of an invalid-parameters error</span></li><li><span>Under <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code>, subagent and workflow child records now land in each child&#x27;s own session log instead of mixing into the parent&#x27;s log, for new and resumed sessions; older sessions with mixed-in child records keep working with no changes</span></li><li><span>A session whose transcript view fell behind a later compaction loads fully again instead of showing &quot;live updates are unavailable&quot; on every restart</span></li><li><span>The verify reminder no longer pushes a full app rebuild or a platform download when you run the build yourself</span></li><li><span>Answers to questions in chat fit on one screen again instead of running to a report; a request for a report, an audit, an inventory, or a file keeps the full detail</span></li></ul><h2 id="v1-4-4" class="docs-h docs-h2">1.4.4<a class="docs-anchor" href="#v1-4-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><h3 id="new-9" class="docs-h docs-h3">New<a class="docs-anchor" href="#new-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>MCP server <code class="docs-code-inline">url</code> and header values in <code class="docs-code-inline">settings.json</code> and a trusted project <code class="docs-code-inline">.mcp.json</code> now expand <code class="docs-code-inline">${VAR}</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">${VAR:-default}</code> from your environment, so a checked-in config can keep its secrets out (write <code class="docs-code-inline">$$</code> for a literal <code class="docs-code-inline">$</code>)</span></li><li><span>Session protocol toolCall items now carry the task&#x27;s latest status detail (status line, phase, progress, step, retry attempt, health, child counts); the Python wire-types package has the matching typed fields</span></li><li><span>Set <code class="docs-code-inline">session_retention_days</code> in your settings file to delete saved sessions you have not opened for that many days; unset keeps sessions forever (macOS and Linux only for now)</span></li><li><span>Session protocol workflow items now carry monitor detail (launch token budget, declared phase, final summary, stop availability, child prompt references); the Python wire-types package has the matching typed fields</span></li><li><span>Shell commands, background monitors and hook commands now see the top-level chat&#x27;s session ID in <code class="docs-code-inline">MUSE_SESSION_ID</code> and the running chat or subagent&#x27;s session ID in <code class="docs-code-inline">MUSE_THREAD_ID</code></span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse exec</code>, the interactive TUI, and <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> accept repeatable <code class="docs-code-inline">-c key=value</code> (<code class="docs-code-inline">--config</code>) flags that set any existing setting for that run only, including MCP servers; secret fields take <code class="docs-code-inline">${VAR}</code> references instead of inline values and managed policy still wins</span></li><li><span>Apps using the session protocol can pause a running workflow and read its paused state on the workflow item</span></li><li><span>Apps using the session protocol can upload video in chunks and attach it to a turn by reference</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> now pushes an experimental <code class="docs-code-inline">session/permissionProfileChanged</code> notification when a session&#x27;s permission profile is set or refreshed after start, from the picker, a resume selection, or a managed refresh, with the profile id now in effect (<code class="docs-code-inline">null</code> for a launch-override profile) and, when a client command caused it, that command&#x27;s id</span></li><li><span>Attached videos now send with your turn instead of being refused</span></li></ul><h3 id="improvements-9" class="docs-h docs-h3">Improvements<a class="docs-anchor" href="#improvements-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>The goal reminder is on by default again for every model except Muse Spark 1.3 at <code class="docs-code-inline">max</code> effort, including models released later, because a long-task benchmark solved more tasks with it on. The todo and memory reminders keep their current defaults, and a saved on or off choice still wins</span></li><li><span>Clearing the input with Ctrl+C now says so, and when the Up arrow can bring the text back it says that too</span></li><li><span>Pressing Esc with text in the input box now shows that Ctrl+C clears it, and <code class="docs-code-inline">/help</code> and the <code class="docs-code-inline">?</code> shortcuts list Ctrl+C as clear, interrupt, or exit</span></li><li><span>Background updates can wake a conversation while a subagent is waiting for approval</span></li><li><span>The goal check now runs by default on new models and treats a requested publish as done only after the publish itself succeeds, so the agent keeps working instead of reporting done after a failed publish</span></li><li><span>When the agent rewrites its plan and drops unfinished steps, the plan panel now says how many were replaced</span></li><li><span>Quitting waits up to 5 seconds for a clean shutdown instead of 2, shows what it is waiting on when the exit is slow, and names that step if it still times out</span></li><li><span>The <code class="docs-code-inline">grill</code> skill now explains decisions in your language and uses comparison tables when they help</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">tbh exec</code> accepts inline <code class="docs-code-inline">--flag=value</code> options</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">tbh exec</code> rejects a repeated single-value option instead of silently keeping the last value</span></li><li><span>The macOS release for Apple silicon now requires macOS 12 or later</span></li><li><span>Long model-prefill waits no longer false-timeout while bytes are still arriving: the pre-content wait now treats transport bytes as liveness (300s silence budget, 1800s overall cap), and a fully silent first attempt gets exactly one escalated retry before the turn fails</span></li><li><span>Inside tmux, web links show only their clickable label when tmux is set to pass hyperlinks through to every attached terminal (for example <code class="docs-code-inline">set -as terminal-features &#x27;,xterm-ghostty:hyperlinks&#x27;</code>); otherwise the address stays visible</span></li><li><span>A running interactive session now refreshes its remote feature settings every four hours instead of only at startup, using the same opt-out as the startup check</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">--effort</code> now works as a shorter alias for <code class="docs-code-inline">--reasoning-effort</code>, both when launching and in <code class="docs-code-inline">exec</code></span></li><li><span>The background command view now shows the whole command over several lines instead of one cut-off line, and it and the monitor view color the command as shell syntax</span></li><li><span>The grill skill&#x27;s scope contract now treats a repository&#x27;s own definition of done as its floor: the boundary cannot exclude what it requires, the &quot;Done means&quot; checklist cannot omit it, and adding it is not scope widening</span></li><li><span>Session-protocol clients can change skill activation over <code class="docs-code-inline">skill/setActivation</code>: turn any skill on or off in user, project, bundled, or plugin scope through the same shared service the app uses, with the previous value echoed in the reply</span></li><li><span>Answers about what a skill runs now name the actual final program in plain words instead of stopping at the entry command</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume &lt;id-or-name&gt;</code> on a session whose saved log can&#x27;t be replayed now starts a new session that reads that log and continues the work, instead of exiting with an error</span></li><li><span>With <code class="docs-code-inline">--disable-sandbox</code>, file tools can read and write outside the workspace whether or not the workspace is trusted and whichever built-in permission profile is selected, unless an administrator has turned off user sandbox overrides; <code class="docs-code-inline">--trust-workspace</code> now only decides whether the workspace&#x27;s skills and rules load</span></li></ul><h3 id="fixes-9" class="docs-h docs-h3">Fixes<a class="docs-anchor" href="#fixes-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> File tools now refuse to read, search, or change credential files (SSH, AWS and GPG keys, keychains, saved browser logins, Git and GitHub CLI credentials) and anything inside the Trash, even through links; the match is by file and folder name, so project files with these names are refused too, and the shell is unaffected</span></li><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Ask me and Auto-review now ask before running dangerous commands hidden behind wrappers such as <code class="docs-code-inline">env LD_PRELOAD=…</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">nice</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">timeout</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">xargs</code>, or a wrapped <code class="docs-code-inline">bash -lc</code> script, matching the unwrapped commands; benign wrapped commands like <code class="docs-code-inline">timeout 5 cargo test</code> still run without asking. A shell invocation that is not a <code class="docs-code-inline">-c</code>/<code class="docs-code-inline">-lc</code> script (for example <code class="docs-code-inline">bash ./run.sh</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">bash -cl &#x27;…&#x27;</code>) also asks instead of auto-running</span></li><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Creating a session worktree in an untrusted Sapling repository is now refused with a clear message instead of running that repository&#x27;s hooks</span></li><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Shell approvals now deny the whole action when a deny rule is added during review, including session approvals and approvals whose rule save failed</span></li><li><span>Long sessions let go of finished task data, so memory grows more slowly over many turns</span></li><li><span>Stopping a background shell now also ends child processes that moved into their own process group (such as <code class="docs-code-inline">timeout</code>-wrapped commands) instead of leaving them running after the stop reports cancelled</span></li><li><span>Keep readable agent paths in subagent message cards</span></li><li><span>Tool calls denied before running, or naming an unknown tool, now show as rejected or failed items with their result text in every session view instead of silently disappearing</span></li><li><span>Scheduled task confirmations no longer promise incorrect repeat intervals</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">--worktree</code> sessions start correctly in sandboxed Git repositories</span></li><li><span>Preserve hook blocks when the same output requests approval or rewrites tool input</span></li><li><span>Paused goals stay paused when the assistant reports a blocker</span></li><li><span>Terminal commands that cannot start now report the real reason instead of running in the background</span></li><li><span>A turn no longer ends with an event-log error when a background command finishes after the conversation was compacted</span></li><li><span>Keep plugin command approvals revoked after rejected input during startup</span></li><li><span>Identify hook matchers whose regex is too big to compile</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/status</code> shows context usage after a turn instead of sticking at not projected</span></li><li><span>Resume sessions correctly when a policy rule denies a compound shell command after its final approval</span></li><li><span>An unreadable <code class="docs-code-inline">settings.json</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">trust.json</code> now prints one warning naming the file and the error, instead of silently running as if the file were missing</span></li><li><span>Linux sandbox preserves explicit write access when a read grant names the same path</span></li><li><span>Recover saved command approvals after repeated restarts</span></li><li><span>A protected file write still waiting for your review when the session restarts now reopens under the same approval instead of being cancelled, so you can decide it without asking for the write again</span></li><li><span>The <code class="docs-code-inline">/</code> command palette shows one row for identical copies of a skill kept in several folders, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">~/.agents</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">~/.claude</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">~/.codex</code>, instead of one row per copy</span></li><li><span>Subagent approval requests remain available when the parent conversation starts another turn</span></li><li><span>Keep background Bash commands recognizable after a session restart</span></li><li><span>Stopped or closed subagents report their final status correctly</span></li><li><span>Long-running sessions resumed after an upgrade no longer become impossible to resume again after their next compaction</span></li><li><span>Keep nested subagent starts and completions in their parent conversation</span></li><li><span>Recent messages and detailed results no longer run together while a tool is still running</span></li><li><span>Text copied from the conversation no longer carries trailing spaces padding each line to the terminal width</span></li><li><span>Long sessions release covered in-memory session mirrors as checkpoints land, so memory grows more slowly over many turns, saved history is unchanged</span></li><li><span>A queued item delivered by a later run is no longer delivered a second time after a restart when a context checkpoint on the delivering run had pruned its delivery record</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">tbh -w</code> creates a session worktree again on macOS instead of failing with Operation not permitted</span></li><li><span>Changing the model while a turn is running now updates the approval reviewer instead of leaving it on the previous model</span></li><li><span>Pressing Enter right after answering a permission prompt no longer sends the half-typed message hidden behind it, and a prompt that just appeared ignores Enter, y, p, and number keys for a moment so a stray keystroke can&#x27;t approve it</span></li><li><span>Sessions served over <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> now load your custom agents just like the interactive app, instead of offering only the built-in agents</span></li><li><span>A resumed session whose profile the enterprise config refloor downgraded to human no longer fails startup when the approval reviewer cannot be built</span></li><li><span>A running session keeps its Linux sandbox when an update replaces its executable before the first sandboxed command, instead of failing to start</span></li><li><span>Quitting while an agent or workflow child is still being admitted no longer stalls shutdown for its whole timeout and ends the session cleanly</span></li><li><span>A Workflow tool call given an object argument now receives the object itself on the Meta provider path instead of a JSON-encoded string</span></li><li><span>Restore readable <code class="docs-code-inline">/loop 2d</code> schedule confirmations that explain the monthly restart</span></li><li><span>Resumed sessions no longer show finished or cancelled subagent rows</span></li><li><span>Background workflows can start after restarting a session without waiting for a new message</span></li><li><span>Generated images now save in workspaces on EdenFS or NFS instead of failing with &quot;write failed&quot;</span></li><li><span>A hook that already finished keeps its real outcome instead of showing cancelled when the run ends at the same moment</span></li><li><span>Keep reported token usage when a background context summary fails</span></li><li><span>Enter in <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> no longer opens a different session when the one you moved to drops out of the list while it refreshes; pick again instead</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">tbh exec</code> rejects an empty <code class="docs-code-inline">--worktree-existing</code> instead of silently using the current directory</span></li><li><span>Prevent scheduled work from running twice after a storage retry, clock rollback, and session resume</span></li><li><span>Fix waits that remain blocked after a nested subagent stops</span></li><li><span>Workflow steps can read full results from earlier steps</span></li><li><span>Starting or resuming a session through the SDKs no longer drops the events delivered together with the reply</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">view/page</code> now refuses a child session, or a session that loaded with no live view, instead of slowly rebuilding its whole history; <code class="docs-code-inline">session/read</code> still returns such a session without its history, and in Zed a session that loaded with no live view opens with an empty transcript</span></li><li><span>The terminal no longer flashes every second while a workflow runs after its progress block has scrolled into history</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">MuseClient.spawn</code> in the Python SDK now raises <code class="docs-code-inline">MuseHostStartError</code>, carrying the host&#x27;s exit code, the last lines of its stderr, and whether the host had already answered the startup handshake, instead of a bare <code class="docs-code-inline">ProtocolError</code> (<code class="docs-code-inline">connection reached EOF</code>)</span></li><li><span>In Vim mode, a counted search repeat such as <code class="docs-code-inline">999999n</code> no longer freezes the composer on a long draft</span></li><li><span>In Vim mode, a search no longer matches inside an emoji or accented letter, so <code class="docs-code-inline">d/</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">c/</code>, and <code class="docs-code-inline">y/</code> never cut a character in half</span></li><li><span>Python SDK <code class="docs-code-inline">on_approval</code> is asked again when a multi-stage approval moves to its next stage, instead of leaving the turn waiting</span></li><li><span>Native subagent results retry cleanly after a temporary session storage failure</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">view/page</code> again serves a child session, or a session that loaded with no live view, when an earlier build saved its view, so Zed shows that transcript instead of an empty one</span></li><li><span>Long turns that finish on their final step now show the final answer instead of an error</span></li><li><span>A long-running session resumed above a capable checkpoint floor no longer stops pruning when checkpoint capture is refused; the floor&#x27;s authority is carried forward into a new prunable checkpoint so the log stays bounded and the session still reopens</span></li><li><span>The TypeScript SDK no longer applies events twice when a second gap notice arrives while it is still filling the first</span></li><li><span>Sessions with MCP servers keep accepting new turns after their context is compacted</span></li><li><span>Long answers no longer wrap a line between inline code or a link and the punctuation right after it</span></li><li><span>After resuming a session, the background-command reminder reports the real time since the command last printed output</span></li><li><span>The Python SDK no longer applies events twice when a second gap notice arrives while it is still filling the first</span></li><li><span>Re-checking a finished background command no longer adds another &quot;Finished&quot; row, repeat polls of an already-reported result stay quiet while still returning the full output</span></li><li><span>Show a background subagent&#x27;s paused, resumed, or redirected state in work status instead of its earlier state</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">MuseClient.spawn</code> in the TypeScript SDK now says why the host could not start, the missing binary, or its exit code and the last lines of its stderr, instead of a bare <code class="docs-code-inline">write EPIPE</code></span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">MuseClient.spawn</code> in the TypeScript SDK reports the real reason when <code class="docs-code-inline">muse</code> answers the startup handshake with a reply the SDK cannot use, such as a version mismatch, and says when the host died after answering rather than at startup</span></li><li><span>Sessions left behind by an unfinished <code class="docs-code-inline">/delete</code> show up in the session list again</span></li><li><span>Background command completion notices that run out of room now say how much of the output is shown and where the full output is saved, instead of silently cutting the end</span></li><li><span>Keep images from earlier turns tied to their original message after periodic context saves</span></li><li><span>Workflow tasks can continue running commands after background results wake them</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> argument errors now use the same wording as the rest of the CLI, repeated <code class="docs-code-inline">--provider</code>/<code class="docs-code-inline">--model</code>/<code class="docs-code-inline">--sandbox-network</code> flags are rejected instead of silently taking the last value, and the attached <code class="docs-code-inline">-c&lt;key=value&gt;</code> spelling is accepted</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/clear</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">/new</code> keep the prepared session available while switching sessions</span></li><li><span>Subagent capacity rejections now say to raise <code class="docs-code-inline">agents.execution_capacity</code> in user settings and start a new session</span></li><li><span>Restarted sessions stop waiting for message receipts when tracking could not start</span></li><li><span>In-app <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> keeps showing &quot;Indexing sessions…&quot; after it loads more rows, until indexing actually finishes</span></li><li><span>Restore background work status when reopening a conversation</span></li><li><span>Resumed sessions keep older background work from replacing newer conversation state</span></li><li><span>Interrupting a request_user_input card before answering any question now reports no consent in the tool result, so the model stops or waits instead of proceeding with the recommended options</span></li><li><span>Checkpoint-covered session mirrors of run starts and user inputs now count against their retention tail, so long sessions stop accumulating them for the process lifetime</span></li><li><span>Turning off web fetch in <code class="docs-code-inline">/settings</code> no longer also stops the model from checking on background work</span></li><li><span>Forking a session now works after a long turn was compacted and then received more of your messages before it finished</span></li><li><span>Switching a session to the Auto-review profile is refused when no reviewer can be prepared, instead of committing a profile that cannot run</span></li><li><span>Linux sandbox errors now name the rejected helper or Bubblewrap binary and the setup change that fixes it</span></li><li><span>Python multiprocessing pools now run inside the macOS managed shell sandbox instead of failing with PermissionError at SemLock</span></li><li><span>On a short terminal, a multi-step command approval now keeps showing which step is up and that step&#x27;s command (cut with … when it is too long), with every choice still visible</span></li><li><span>A background child that moved into its own process group (for example under coreutils <code class="docs-code-inline">timeout</code>) no longer survives process shutdown or fixed-child cleanup, the exit sweep and the web-fetch child settle now check the leader&#x27;s whole session before deciding nothing is left to kill</span></li><li><span>Subagent worktree creation over serve on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox now succeeds for trusted workspaces instead of refusing; untrusted workspaces still refuse with the trust-or-sandboxing remedy</span></li><li><span>Sessions with MCP servers keep accepting new turns after a later turn compacts the conversation, and a failed MCP link is reported as such instead of as an MCP startup audit failure</span></li><li><span>Long mirror sessions no longer stop publishing compaction checkpoints after a few dozen turns: the preserved recent suffix is now capped against the hard context limit instead of growing with the whole history, so each replacement stays small enough to install</span></li><li><span>Effort picker and settings cycle offer only the reasoning levels the active model supports</span></li><li><span>A chat whose model is no longer offered now stops right away with a message listing the models you can switch to, instead of retrying for several minutes and ending in an internal server error</span></li><li><span>Compacting a session that was started in the terminal app and later reopened through <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> no longer fails as if the conversation had changed</span></li><li><span>Approval cards on short panes fit the command to the panel so every choice stays visible</span></li><li><span>After <code class="docs-code-inline">/compact</code>, the compaction now shows as finished only once its own cleanup is done, so a message sent right after &quot;Compacted&quot; is no longer refused as busy by the compaction</span></li><li><span>File edits inside a <code class="docs-code-inline">--worktree</code> session worktree no longer ask for approval every time, Auto-review now handles them like edits in the main checkout, while the worktree&#x27;s own <code class="docs-code-inline">.git</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">.muse</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">.agents</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">.husky</code> metadata still needs your approval</span></li></ul><h3 id="performance-8" class="docs-h docs-h3">Performance<a class="docs-anchor" href="#performance-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> lists the sessions Muse has already indexed right away, while it checks the rest in the background</span></li><li><span>Long sessions stay responsive as background activity rows arrive, even with many earlier prompts in the session</span></li><li><span>With no session index, or one missing many sessions, <code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> now lists your newest sessions while it indexes the rest instead of waiting for all of them</span></li><li><span>Checking on a session that is not open no longer re-reads its whole saved transcript when nothing has changed since the last check</span></li><li><span>Faster startup when a cached model list is available</span></li><li><span>With no session index, in-app <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> now indexes several sessions at once, so the full list finishes sooner</span></li><li><span>Cancelling a command with a large process tree is faster on busy machines because teardown now scans the process table once instead of once per process in the tree</span></li><li><span>Session retention cleanup does less background work when many saved sessions are old</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> no longer takes tens of seconds to start answering when many sessions are saved</span></li><li><span>Long in-progress sessions stay responsive; transcript trimming no longer rescans history beyond its size caps on every frame</span></li><li><span>Long tool-heavy sessions stay responsive instead of repeatedly re-parsing earlier tool output</span></li></ul><h2 id="v1-4-3" class="docs-h docs-h2">1.4.3<a class="docs-anchor" href="#v1-4-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><h3 id="new-10" class="docs-h docs-h3">New<a class="docs-anchor" href="#new-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Session protocol <code class="docs-code-inline">reminderChild</code> items carry <code class="docs-code-inline">blocking: true</code> when the reminder holds the turn open, so apps can say which reminder the turn is waiting on</span></li><li><span>Plugin management is on by default, browse, install, and create plugins from <code class="docs-code-inline">/plugins</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">muse plugins</code>, or the Settings Plugins row with no setup</span></li><li><span>Each image on a message now carries a stable id apps can use to refer to it</span></li><li><span>Set <code class="docs-code-inline">ca_bundle</code> to your company&#x27;s CA file and model providers plus telemetry trust it, so corporate networks that inspect traffic connect instead of failing; certificate problems now report a clear error instead of retrying</span></li><li><span>Workflow items served by <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> now report the run&#x27;s real duration and, for each child that failed, its failure kind and reason</span></li><li><span>Session protocol clients can read the hook and plugin catalogs over <code class="docs-code-inline">hook/list</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">plugin/list</code></span></li><li><span>A reopened session can show that its last turn failed: <code class="docs-code-inline">session/resume</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">session/read</code> now return how the last turn ended, with its error, as <code class="docs-code-inline">lastTurn</code></span></li><li><span>Session protocol clients can track hook runs in the session view as hookRun items</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/resume &lt;id-or-name&gt;</code> inside Muse Code switches straight to that session, like <code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume &lt;id-or-name&gt;</code></span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse exec --disable-reminders</code> runs without reminder agents</span></li><li><span>Session protocol serves <code class="docs-code-inline">turn/foregroundCompleted</code> when the answer is done but background reminder checks still hold the turn open, so apps can stop showing &quot;Working…&quot; while the checks run</span></li></ul><h3 id="improvements-10" class="docs-h docs-h3">Improvements<a class="docs-anchor" href="#improvements-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Queued input uses a shared tree with agent names and delivery hints</span></li><li><span>When the agent pauses its automatic <code class="docs-code-inline">/goal</code> follow-up turns, the goal progress row shows for how long, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">snoozed 15m</code></span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse exec</code> and offline sessions using Spark 1.3 contributor now default to max reasoning effort, like connected sessions</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse exec</code> and offline sessions now include web fetch like connected sessions</span></li><li><span>Reasoning effort picks are now remembered per model, so switching models restores each model&#x27;s own saved effort</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse trace inspect --causal</code> shows which model request message contains an installed summary</span></li><li><span>Removed the <code class="docs-code-inline">/delete</code> command</span></li><li><span>HTTPS clients trust your system&#x27;s certificate store alongside the built-in roots, so corporate networks that inspect traffic connect without extra configuration</span></li><li><span>Live watches and realtime connections trust your system&#x27;s certificate store and honor proxy settings, so corporate networks that inspect traffic connect without extra configuration</span></li><li><span>Clarify cumulative token usage and current context estimates in <code class="docs-code-inline">/status</code></span></li><li><span>Repeated scheduled-task fires from the same job now show as one summary row instead of one row per fire</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse exec --disable-write</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">--disable-shell</code> no longer offer the disabled tools to the model</span></li><li><span>Sessions now report whether they are a top-level session or a subagent, which session a subagent belongs to, and which client opened them, so clients can tell them apart without guessing from folder names</span></li><li><span>Exit confirmation now defaults to Exit anyway so Enter confirms the exit</span></li><li><span>Rewind can again reach the earlier turns of a long session after its automatic history checkpoint, with the same history the branch would have had without the checkpoint</span></li><li><span>Ephemeral <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve --no-session-log</code> sessions can now change approval modes freely during a session (switching to or from &quot;always allow&quot; and the other approval modes is no longer locked to the mode the session started with); managed policy still applies</span></li><li><span>The queued-input panel now shows <code class="docs-code-inline">↑ to edit</code> when pressing Up would pull your queued messages back into the composer</span></li><li><span>The session protocol no longer offers <code class="docs-code-inline">session/delete</code>; a client that sends it gets a method-not-found error</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">work_status</code> reports running and terminal states for background monitors and shows naturally completed native subagents as paused with a result ready</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> clients can steer a skill into a running turn by sending its skill part to <code class="docs-code-inline">turn/start</code> with <code class="docs-code-inline">ifBusy: &quot;steer&quot;</code></span></li><li><span>While a turn is running, a skill typed or picked in the composer now steers into the turn with Enter or waits for the next turn with Alt+Enter, instead of being refused</span></li><li><span>While a turn is running, Tab now queues your message for the next turn and Alt+Enter inserts a new line, so Alt+Enter works the same in tmux whether or not a turn is running; with nothing to queue, Tab inserts a tab. If you set your own <code class="docs-code-inline">composer.newline</code> keys, add <code class="docs-code-inline">alt+enter</code> to keep it as a newline</span></li></ul><h3 id="fixes-10" class="docs-h docs-h3">Fixes<a class="docs-anchor" href="#fixes-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><strong>Security:</strong> Worktree creation from untrusted sources runs sandboxed and refuses when no sandbox can protect it</span></li><li><span>Recover the latest hook-blocked prompt when new input arrives as a run finishes</span></li><li><span>Pressing Ctrl+C to clear a draft now also removes its pasted images and videos, so a new video can be pasted right away</span></li><li><span>Switching sessions with <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> no longer freezes on &quot;Restoring conversation&quot; until the next keypress</span></li><li><span>TypeScript SDK connections no longer retain every command payload in memory</span></li><li><span>TypeScript SDK no longer opens a console window when it starts on Windows</span></li><li><span>A pasted video whose upload stalls now times out and retries instead of hanging the turn</span></li><li><span>The terminal no longer flashes each time a running workflow reports progress</span></li><li><span>Workflow progress, completion, and save-as use recorded names and hide anonymous internal identifiers</span></li><li><span>The session list orders by latest activity, so reopening a session no longer moves it to the top</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/goal</code> works in a session that was interrupted before its first goal, instead of failing with a goal-store custody error</span></li><li><span>After you answer an approval, Esc and typing no longer reopen it and fail with &quot;approval decision failed&quot; while the prompt is still closing</span></li><li><span>Load ancestor project rules in Sapling repositories</span></li><li><span>Subagent nudges and close-outs keep working after a session resumes from a checkpoint</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> recovers sessions with very large saved snapshots</span></li><li><span>In <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code>, rows you scrolled past stay in place when other sessions change; a note says when sessions changed above, and moving back to the top shows them</span></li><li><span>Accepting the workspace-trust prompt during <code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> no longer leaves a blank terminal, the startup progress row stays visible through the post-prompt load instead of going dark until the transcript appears</span></li><li><span>Model timeout error no longer blames your local network when the service does not respond</span></li><li><span>A rejected turn or steer replayed after a session resumes answers the recorded rejection instead of being re-judged, and a new turn can no longer start under a rejected command id</span></li><li><span>Sessions with a damaged view stay usable and report history as unavailable instead of failing with an internal error</span></li><li><span>Recover the latest hook-blocked prompt when older queued inputs share its text</span></li><li><span>A model request stuck on a failing server route now moves to a fresh route after three server errors instead of retrying the same route ten times</span></li><li><span>Max reasoning effort now shows for settings-listed models that declare it</span></li><li><span>Muse now starts when a project or home folder has a plain file named .agents, .codex, or .claude, skipping that skills location instead of exiting with &quot;Not a directory&quot;</span></li><li><span>After a restart, approving a re-presented ordinary approval now runs the tool exactly once instead of accepting but doing nothing; denying still never runs it</span></li><li><span>After a restart, a fresh protected review stays pending for a connected reviewer until they decide it instead of aborting before the first <code class="docs-code-inline">approval/listPending</code>; a resume with truly no reviewer still aborts fail-closed</span></li><li><span>Resume recovers sessions that previously stopped with a permission recovery error</span></li><li><span>Preserve a forked session&#x27;s checkpoint state after reopening</span></li><li><span>Ctrl+C and Ctrl+D in a side chat now return to the main chat instead of quitting the whole session, and the side status row says whether the key stops the running side turn or returns</span></li><li><span>A finished run no longer freezes the session while it tidies up its compaction summary in the background, so the command that ends the run stops timing out</span></li><li><span>Resuming a session no longer fails while background indexing reads it, and the already-open error no longer names a program that already exited</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> rejects a session start whose saved default profile needs an automated reviewer this host does not have with a clear <code class="docs-code-inline">permission_profile_reviewer_unavailable</code> reason instead of an internal error</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/feedback</code> upload failures now show the server&#x27;s reason instead of only the status code</span></li><li><span>After a resume falls back to a recovery checkpoint, earlier chat history stays visible instead of the conversation looking empty</span></li><li><span>A named toolset (<code class="docs-code-inline">run.toolset</code>) can now select MCP tools by their full name, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">mcp__docs__search</code>; if a selected MCP tool is still missing after the MCP servers start, the run stops before contacting the model and lists every missing name</span></li><li><span>The warning for a plugin blocked by changed cache files now names the changed or missing files and says to update or reinstall the plugin</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse plugins approve &lt;plugin-id&gt;</code> succeeds for an installed plugin that has nothing to review</span></li><li><span>Sessions whose saved history view was written by an older build and could no longer be restored now rebuild it from the session log on resume, instead of showing history as unavailable on every load</span></li><li><span>Reopening a session that contains a record written by a newer version now shows the rest of its history instead of an empty conversation</span></li><li><span>Claude plugins with hooks that set <code class="docs-code-inline">asyncRewake</code> or <code class="docs-code-inline">once</code> now install, skipping just those hooks with a warning instead of refusing the whole plugin</span></li><li><span>A plugin whose cached files are missing or damaged no longer blocks installing or updating other plugins; Muse warns and names the <code class="docs-code-inline">muse plugins update</code> command that repairs it</span></li><li><span>Reading a large image file no longer sends the model a copy several times bigger than the file</span></li><li><span>When a trusted project folder cannot be verified, the MCP startup error now names that folder and the reason instead of blaming a missing <code class="docs-code-inline">.mcp.json</code> file</span></li><li><span>&quot;Loaded skill&quot; now appears only when a skill is actually loaded, not when its text just shows up in a message, a tool output, or another skill</span></li><li><span>Let large sessions carry pending results before compaction when the complete request fits the configured context budget. Manual compaction now explains when pending results need a completed model turn first</span></li><li><span>Claude plugins whose command files use capital letters, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">reviewPullRequest.md</code>, now install, and each command runs by its exact name</span></li><li><span>Plugins that list other plugins they depend on now install instead of being refused, and <code class="docs-code-inline">muse plugins validate</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">muse plugins install</code> show whether each of those plugins is installed and warn about the missing ones</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/name</code> explains why session naming is unavailable and how to recover</span></li><li><span>A settled approval in an open session now points at the same place in its history as the session&#x27;s saved view, on any machine</span></li><li><span>A served session resume that your permission policy blocks now explains it was refused by permission policy and how to recover, instead of wrongly telling you to retry on a compatible host</span></li><li><span>Starting inside tmux no longer hangs before the first screen when a tmux query does not answer</span></li><li><span>Resuming a long session that keeps receiving subagent or background notifications now starts from its latest compaction instead of rereading the whole session log</span></li><li><span>The todo list above the prompt stays visible between runs while a scheduled task is still active, instead of disappearing after each run and reappearing at the next one</span></li><li><span>Resuming an empty session no longer shows a false crash warning</span></li><li><span>Reopened SDK sessions keep the Workflows setting and can run workflows; sessions restored from compaction or periodic checkpoints can also be renamed</span></li><li><span>Model failures now suggest checking service status and retrying</span></li><li><span>Side chat no longer refuses to start on compacted sessions</span></li><li><span>Staged work keeps a todo item for each named stage and checks it off when tool output proves that stage landed, so the visible plan no longer stays on a finished stage</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/exit</code> typed right after a Workflow launch now asks before quitting instead of exiting without the confirm and abandoning the run</span></li><li><span>Ephemeral <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve --no-session-log</code> sessions with a configured permission profile now honor approval-mode changes during the session (switching to &quot;always allow&quot; takes effect for the next action instead of still asking); on those configured ephemeral sessions a native auto-review child inheriting a managed prompt reservation is now refused like the session&#x27;s own actions, while durable sessions and profile-less hosts keep their existing child behavior</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse resume</code> no longer refuses a session after you pressed Esc on a turn that had just compacted; that Esc now stops the turn and keeps your message instead of putting it back in the composer</span></li><li><span>Opaque workflow child failures now report their specific error kind</span></li><li><span>A message sent while a background compaction is wrapping up now starts after it instead of being rejected with &quot;the runtime is busy&quot;</span></li><li><span>Keep the Sent marker visible when a session message&#x27;s delivery is unconfirmed</span></li><li><span>Keep images available when compaction removes a video from the current turn</span></li><li><span>Preserve work-stop notices when a session is interrupted</span></li><li><span>Pasted text that arrives in split terminal reads collapses into one placeholder instead of stranding leading characters outside it</span></li><li><span>Feedback can now be sent with no session open</span></li><li><span>Plugin tools can show their own running and completed names. Image generation now shows Generating image and Generated image, while image editing shows Editing image and Edited image</span></li><li><span>Background message tasks stop polling for unsupported delivery receipts</span></li><li><span>Stopping your own background Bash task with <code class="docs-code-inline">work_stop</code> now settles the transcript row to the task&#x27;s real ending (for example <code class="docs-code-inline">Stopping work — cancelled</code>) instead of leaving it as <code class="docs-code-inline">unresolved — manual reconciliation required</code></span></li><li><span>Reconnecting to an open session from a machine with different settings now replays its history with the same numbering as its saved view</span></li><li><span>Report the full wait in model failure summaries instead of starting the clock at the first failure</span></li><li><span>Let stopped subagents finish cleanup when cancellation is recorded by their parent</span></li><li><span>Zero-byte model responses now preserve the final attempt request ID</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/clear</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">/new</code>, and in-TUI <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> no longer crash with &quot;old runtime did not stop within 2s&quot; on slow machines, the new session appears right away while the old one finishes saving in the background, and you get one notice with the old session&#x27;s resume command if that save does not finish cleanly</span></li></ul><h3 id="performance-9" class="docs-h docs-h3">Performance<a class="docs-anchor" href="#performance-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Shutting down many stdio MCP servers at once no longer stalls: they share one scan of the process table instead of each scanning every process on the machine</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> lists saved sessions right away while the app indexes new ones in the background, instead of reading them all first</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/resume</code> in the default app lists sessions from one background indexer, newest first, as it writes them, instead of reading every session log again</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/resume --last</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">/resume &lt;name&gt;</code> no longer reread every saved session once Muse has indexed them in the background</span></li><li><span>Long sessions use less peak memory per model step: building the provider request now moves the message history instead of copying it, cutting the per-step spike that grew with history length</span></li></ul><h2 id="v1-4-2" class="docs-h docs-h2">1.4.2<a class="docs-anchor" href="#v1-4-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><h3 id="new-11" class="docs-h docs-h3">New<a class="docs-anchor" href="#new-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">/delete</code> asks before removing the current session and its child sessions; video-enabled sessions and sessions with unverified log ownership are kept with an explanation</span></li><li><span>Background Bash commands return a Work ID so agents can stop the command</span></li><li><span>Muse session protocol clients can grant several workspace roots at once, <code class="docs-code-inline">session/start</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">turn/start</code> accept a <code class="docs-code-inline">workspaceRoots</code> list of absolute paths; every listed root gets the same write access as the primary root, and a <code class="docs-code-inline">turn/start</code> list replaces the set for that turn and later turns</span></li><li><span>Added <code class="docs-code-inline">muse voice transcribe &lt;file&gt;</code></span></li><li><span>Added <code class="docs-code-inline">muse model-profile show &lt;model&gt; --effort &lt;level&gt;</code>, which prints what a model actually resolves to for each setting at that effort level</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">session/list</code> accepts an optional <code class="docs-code-inline">filter</code> that narrows the list by session ID, branch, or name and title words, and echoes the filter it applied as <code class="docs-code-inline">appliedFilter</code></span></li><li><span>The TUI serve lane honors several workspace roots at once, every listed root gets the same write access as the primary root, each extra root&#x27;s own rules file loads under that root&#x27;s recorded trust, and the system prompt names every root; extra roots never gain project trust</span></li><li><span><code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> accepts feedback submitted by connected clients</span></li><li><span>Choose the provider and model for one <code class="docs-code-inline">muse serve</code> process with <code class="docs-code-inline">--provider</code> and <code class="docs-code-inline">--model</code>, without changing saved settings</span></li></ul><h3 id="improvements-11" class="docs-h docs-h3">Improvements<a class="docs-anchor" href="#improvements-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>The <code class="docs-code-inline">model/list</code> described-level schema type is now <code class="docs-code-inline">ModelDescribedReasoningEffort</code>, and per-level <code class="docs-code-inline">description</code> is omitted when the catalog declares none</span></li><li><span>Subagent-tree live rows now breathe color smoothly, the ◆/◈/◇ glyph brightens and dims smoothly instead of stepping through a few held shades, matching the resume startup row</span></li><li><span>A follow-up sent while your lane is still busy gets an immediate &quot;Received, on it.&quot; instead of silence until the current step ends</span></li><li><span>Show alt(option) in tmux shortcut hints and explain Mac modifier names in shortcut help</span></li><li><span>Automatic history-preserving checkpoints every 16 MiB of session log are now off by default while their follow-up fixes land; set <code class="docs-code-inline">context_compaction.periodic_checkpoint_bytes</code> to a positive byte count (for example 16777216) to opt back in, and compaction checkpoints are unaffected</span></li><li><span>Retry stalled model responses through the remaining attempt budget</span></li><li><span>Verify reminder no longer accepts a scoped &quot;not run&quot;
